Company Profile

Daishang Bags is operated by Shanghai Daishang International Trading Co., Ltd., focusing on custom canvas bags, non-woven bags, drawstring bags and felt bags for B2B buyers. We support custom logo printing, custom size, custom colors, private label options and OEM/ODM production.
